From Proto-Turkic *sat-ïg-čï (“seller”), from Proto-Turkic *sat- (“to sell”). Inherited from Ottoman Turkish صاتیجی (satıcı). Equivalent to sat- (“to sell”) + -ıcı. Cognate with Bashkir һатыусы (hatıwsı, “seller”), Dolgan атыыһыт (“merchant”), Chuvash сутуҫӑ (sut̬uś̬ă, “salesperson”), etc.
